item.iridescent_relics.relic_essence.too: Crystallized residue of spent relics. The Relic Broker's coin.
item.iridescent_relics.remnant_relic.too: A pulsing heart of ancient sandstone, warm to the touch.
tooltip.relics.remnant_relic.ability.hea: The remnant's enduring pulse fortifies the bearer's flesh against time itself.
tooltip.relics.remnant_relic.ability.spe: Ancient sandstone hums in sympathy with woven spells, amplifying their force.
item.iridescent_relics.frostmaw_heart.to: A shard of everwinter, cold enough to numb the hand that holds it.
tooltip.relics.frostmaw_heart.ability.ar: A rime of unmelting frost sheathes the bearer, blunting incoming blows.
item.iridescent_relics.ironheart_cog.too: A massive gear torn from the Wroughtnaut's chest, still warm with old furnace-heat.
tooltip.relics.ironheart_cog.ability.arm: Living iron grafts to the bearer, turning aside steel and stone alike.
tooltip.relics.ironheart_cog.ability.kno: The cog's weight roots the bearer like an anchored engine, shrugging off impacts.
A golden plume from the Sun Spirit, radiant and weightless.
Captured sunlight deepens the bearer's reservoir of magic.
A splinter of the Twilight Lich's soul-vessel, humming with stolen time.
The phylactery siphons moments from the weave, quickening the bearer's spells.
A pearl the size of a fist, dredged from the deep-sea horror's gut.
The crushing weight of the depths toughens the bearer's body.
An echo of the Leviathan's hunger lends savagery to every strike.
item.iridescent_relics.cursed_sigil_prid: Lucifer's brand. It whispers of glory, and feeds on the vanity it grants.
tooltip.relics.cursed_sigil_pride.abilit: Infernal arrogance floods the bearer's magic with overwhelming force.
The sigil sharpens every blow with the fury of the fallen.
Pride hollows the flesh: the bearer's life is forfeit to feed their hubris.
item.iridescent_relics.dragons_eye.toolt: The unblinking eye of the Ender Dragon, still gleaming with ancient menace.
tooltip.relics.dragons_eye.ability.healt: The dragon's vitality courses through the bearer, swelling their lifeblood.
tooltip.relics.dragons_eye.ability.crit_: The dragon's gaze marks every weakness, guiding strikes to their mark.
When a blow lands true, draconic wrath multiplies the carnage.
